summary: Verified urgent Fix Brand bug fix. Backend edit-brand endpoint now returns in ~0.12s in queued mode (was 65s). DB stamps brand_edited_at + reprocessing_started_at immediately. Frontend Fix Brand modal shows correct success toast in ~0.14s and closes; NO 'Network error' seen. Regression endpoints (consumer campaigns, app-settings, admin sync/jobs, qr-links) all pass.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is ~7687 lines — should be split into routers by domain (bills, admin, consumer, brands). Recommend follow-up refactor.

_reprocess_after_brand_edit creates a fresh BackgroundTasks() instance and passes to _reprocess_single_bill — this is fine only if the callee handles bg synchronously; if it schedules nested tasks they won't be awaited by FastAPI. Confirmed working today but is a subtle foot-gun.
Frontend Bills.jsx uses hardcoded 10s/25s refresh timers; if Fundle takes longer under load the UI may show stale data until user manually refreshes.
seed_data_creation: None — used existing pending_review bills (2 available).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Bug fix verified end-to-end. Bill IDs used for edit-brand testing: 1fe182d9-83cc-40d3-bd0e-e22b2f45cd4e. Endpoint measured latency: 0.12s backend, 0.14s frontend-observed. Legacy sync path (wait_for_result=true) NOT explicitly tested (would take 30-60s and rely on Fundle staging availability); main agent's curl-based verification confirms it. Bulk-reprocess flow also NOT re-tested (existing tests in iterations 27-29 cover it).
rca of the issue: Original bug: /api/admin/bills/{id}/edit-brand called Fundle earn_points synchronously inside the request handler (30-60s with image upload) + fallback force-credit path (another 5-10s) → total ~65s. Cloudflare/browser fetch timed out at ~30s → generic 'Network error' toast. Fix: refactor to FastAPI BackgroundTasks — request handler updates DB immediately (store_name, brand_edited_at, reprocessing_started_at) and returns {reprocessed:'queued'} in <200ms; _reprocess_after_brand_edit runs the full pipeline post-response. Frontend Bills.jsx handles queued response with success toast + timed refetches (10s and 25s). AbortController added as 20s safety net.
